description: Netlify modern web deployment: Netlify Functions, Edge Functions, automated branch previews, form handling, custom redirect rules (_redirects), and split testing configurations.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Netlify Jamstack & Edge Functions Architecture

Deploy, automate, and route Jamstack applications and edge functions on Netlify.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Define all build configurations, headers, and redirects declaratively in `netlify.toml`.
- Enforce strict Content Security Policy (CSP) and security headers across all edge responses.
- Isolate preview deployments per Git branch with independent environment variables.
- Monitor serverless function execution times and handle external timeouts gracefully.
